title: D18/PY-IT/eC9 anchor-paper field-generation evidence audit
decision_question: Does the primary D18/PY-IT/eC9 anchor paper, as inspected in this run, establish field-dependent free-charge-generation robustness on the ternary useful-work arm?

accepted_examples: TDCF across prospectively frozen prebias/collection conditions
bias-dependent PL with independently justified mapping to field-dependent generation

primary_source.citation: Luo et al., Suppressing electron-phonon coupling and energy loss in organic solar cells by modulating donor-acceptor penetrated-interface, Nature Communications 17, 2026 (2026)
primary_source.license_note: Article states CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; this repository records provenance and independent audit metadata rather than copying figures or upstream data.

source_observations.observation: The charge-generation section reports PP-TAS and PPP-TAS for PA and SMA systems and interprets hole-transfer and bound-CTE separation kinetics.
article_locations: Results: Charge generation dynamics with the effects of P-interface
supports: charge-transfer/CTE kinetics in the studied binary-system series
does_not_by_itself_support: field-dependent free-charge-generation robustness of D18/PY-IT/eC9 ternary device

source_observations.observation: The article reports the optimized 1:0.2:1 pseudo-bulk-heterojunction ternary device with approximately 20 meV higher Voc, over 18% efficiency, and no sacrifice in Jsc or FF, with Figure 5f identified as a J-V curve.
article_locations: Results: Non-radiative energy loss from E- and P-interfaces

quantitative_inputs.name: reported_Voc_increase
quantitative_inputs.decision_use: context only; not used as a physical acceptance threshold

supports: champion J-V / voltage-loss motivation for the ternary commercial bridge

source_observations.observation: Search of the inspected article text returned no occurrence of TDCF or bias-dependent PL.
supports: main-article field-generation evidence is not established by those named methods
does_not_support: a claim that no such evidence exists anywhere in Supplementary Information, the Figshare record, or author-held data

reason: The inspected primary article establishes binary-system TAS/PPP-TAS charge-generation kinetics and ternary J-V/Voc evidence, but does not establish a field-dependent generation measurement on the ternary useful-work arm. Supplementary/Figshare completeness was not independently proven in this run, so the correct state is INCOMPLETE rather than ABSENT.

fail_closed_rule.expression: eligible_for_field_robustness_claim = ternary_specific AND field_dependent AND provenance_complete

strongest_conventional_explanations: The ternary device may in fact have field-robust generation; the anchor paper's main text may simply not report the required measurement.
Supplementary Information, the cited Figshare record, or author-held data may contain a qualifying ternary field-dependent measurement not verified in this run.

Fast PP/PPP-TAS charge-transfer kinetics can coexist with field-dependent free-charge-generation losses under operating bias, so zero/unspecified-field kinetics are not a substitute for the project gate.
falsifier: Reclassify this audit if a primary-source, provenance-complete D18/PY-IT/eC9 ternary dataset is identified that directly measures field-dependent free-charge generation under defined conditions.
next_physical_measurement: Blinded B0 baseline followed by B1/B2 TDCF and/or bias-dependent PL under prospectively frozen bias, fluence, timing, temperature, morphology/thickness, and contact controls.
